model_minus_expression_topk_rank.interpretation_limit: CI spanning zero is an unresolved difference, not equivalence or parity

model_minus_expression_topk_binary.interpretation_limit: CI spanning zero is an unresolved difference, not equivalence or parity

model_minus_expression_full.interpretation_limit: CI spanning zero is an unresolved difference, not equivalence or parity

sampled_cache_validation.coverage_limit: Only sampled cached rows are re-extracted; this does not establish identity or correctness for unsampled rows

cohort_checks.archived_linkage_limit: Archived state manifest has no expression-file hash or obs_names; current hashes and positional checks preserve supplied provenance but cannot independently prove the historical cohort linkage

definitions.selection: Full-panel positive-gene ranking, descending expression, stable panel-order ties; top k before any projection
definitions.expression: h5ad.X as provided, no second normalization
definitions.preprocessing: Whole-cohort PCA50(random_state=0) then StandardScaler, before five-fold Ridge; archived ruler, not fold-fitted preprocessing
definitions.probe: 5-fold KFold(shuffle=True,random_state=0), Ridge(alpha=10) on cos/sin of oriented phase
definitions.constant: Whole-cohort mean-phase reference; zero circular R-squared by score definition, not a fitted predictor
definitions.random: Independent uniform phases with recorded seed
definitions.bootstrap: Paired cohort-cell percentile intervals with fixed OOF fits and resampled score denominator; not fold-refitting or cross-experiment uncertainty
definitions.phase_labels: Derived from marker expression; expression baselines have a definitional advantage
definitions.comparison: No equivalence margin or equivalence test; intervals spanning zero are unresolved differences
